email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoInsulex patient with a mild skin rash
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 33-year-old female patient with a history of type 1 diabetes received their first dose of DemoInsulex (dose: 2 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on the fourth of March.
Approximately 2 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
R. Silva (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter671@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
